A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same LRDUN research. Their complete main texts and supplementary materials are readable, allowing the methods, equations, experiments, tables, and figures to be matched despite appendix additions and layout changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original LRDUN reconstruction results, real CASSI reconstructions, and component ablations in Tables 1–3, Table S1, and the main and supplementary figures.

after.justification: v2 retains the original reconstruction experiments and ablations and additionally reports lightweight-method comparisons and inference timings in Tables S2–S3.

M1.justification: The alternating PGD procedure, low-rank representation, GFUM, QR retraction, SCAB architecture, and training objective remain unchanged. The added comparison with prior feature-unfolding work clarifies positioning without introducing a new component or procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions train on CAVE, evaluate ten KAIST scenes, and use the same five real CASSI measurements. The added efficiency comparisons establish no new dataset, task, or sensing scenario. Remote sensing and medical imaging remain proposed future applications.

E2.justification: New Table S2 compares LRDUN-3stg against BiSRNet and MST++. MST++ was cited in v1 but was not an evaluated comparator; it is distinct from Table 1's MST-L. Existing comparison sets remain intact. Table S3 mentions five competitors but omits their names.

E3.justification: Supplementary Section 4 adds inference latency as an evaluation measure, tested on a single 256×256×28 scene. Existing training settings, data splits, reconstruction metrics, and model configurations are retained. The new timing experiment lacks a detailed measurement protocol.

E4.justification: The LR-embedding, feature-dimension, rank-selection, attention, and QR-retraction ablation designs remain unchanged, as do the qualitative case studies. The added head-to-head efficiency comparisons introduce no new ablation or robustness condition; the small Table S1 numerical correction is covered under E6.

E5.justification: Neither version reports seeds, repeated-training-run counts, confidence intervals, significance tests, or uncertainty bars. Table S3 is captioned as average runtime but supplies no repetition count or statistical estimation procedure.

E6.justification: Table S2 adds BiSRNet results of 29.76 dB/0.837 SSIM and MST++ results of 35.99 dB/0.951 SSIM. Table S3 adds six timings spanning 78–218 ms without method headers. Table S1 and Section 5.6 change 39.43 to 39.44 dB. Tables 1–3 otherwise retain their numerical results.

T1.justification: The imaging-model derivations, optimization equations, and supplementary Stiefel-manifold/QR reasoning are retained. Changing I_MN to I_HW near Equations 7–8 and standardizing the concatenation separator in Equation 21 correct notation without changing the mathematical argument.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: two low-rank imaging models, alternating-PGD LRDUN, GFUM, and a favorable reconstruction-quality/computation trade-off. The shortened conclusion and additional supporting comparisons do not redefine these claims.

C2.justification: New supplementary Section 6 adds substantive applicability qualifications absent from v1: nonlinear sensing and calibration mismatch, scene-dependent shortcomings of fixed rank, greater resource use than some lightweight methods, and untested application domains. It also attributes weaker real-data reconstruction to model mismatch and hardware artifacts.

D1.justification: v2 adds a code-availability statement and repository address in the abstract. Training hyperparameters, hardware, and implementation descriptions remain unchanged. The QR and SCAB details referenced by the new supplementary-material pointer were already present in v1.

R1.justification: Section 4.3 adds two compressed-sensing references and explicitly distinguishes GFUM through alternating multivariable optimization and physically informative auxiliary features. The supplement adds the BiSRNet reference. Several background citations are removed, and erroneous TSA-Net attributions are corrected; the overall research positioning remains stable.

P1.justification: v2 locally rewrites the visual-results, real-world-results, and LR-ablation discussions, shortens the conclusion, and adds acknowledgments. The supplement gains lightweight-comparison, runtime, and limitations sections, while retaining its existing explanations and visual-results section.

P2.justification: v2 adds Tables S2–S3, reduces Figure 3 and relabels Q/V as Att/Val, and corrects PNSR to PSNR in Figure 6. Supplementary figures are retained and repositioned around the expanded text. The new runtime table lacks method-column labels.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves transparency through explicit limitations, clearer GFUM positioning, corrected citations and numerical inconsistencies, and code-access information. Table S2 broadens the efficiency comparison. These gains are limited because the core evidence is unchanged and the new runtime table omits method labels and measurement details, weakening its evidential value.
